newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Thursday closed slightly up in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 597.41 from 596.76 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was one million dinars against 3.10 million dinars.
Coca-Cola bottler SFBT continued on its downward trend, easing 3.03 dinars to 118.7 dinars. BDET bank was down 1.69 dinar to 19.58 dinars.
Amen bank was up 1.62 dinar to 55.62 dinars. Banque de Tunisie won 1.6 dinar to 78 dinars.
